dsh-imessage is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Two-way iMessage channel for DeepSeek Harness over Photon: sender allowlisting, session commands, in-chat approvals and questions, and a Settings page for device authorization and hosted-line setup.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-81810e59d8d679024107.html
